@graph.name: bridge-adapter-clinvar fixtures
@graph.description: Provenance for every file under fixtures/ of the Cascade Bridge Adapter for ClinVar VCV XML, and for every remote dataset the adapter references. Committed inputs carry a sha256 computed locally over the committed bytes. Remote datasets carry the md5 NCBI publishes in the .md5 file beside each release. Four inputs and their expected graphs and findings are copied byte for byte from the conformance repository; their fetch date and method were not recorded when they were captured, and each entry says so. Dates and sizes for remote files were read from ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov on 2026-09-06.

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV monthly release, 2026-09
@graph.description: Every VariationArchive in ClinVar at ReleaseDate 2026-08-29, in the ClinVarVariationRelease envelope, declaring xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation http://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/xsd_public/ClinVar_VCV_2.6.xsd (read from the first 256 KB of the file on 2026-09-06). md5 is NCBI's, from the sibling .md5 file. Size and date are from the HTTPS headers (Last-Modified 2026-09-03T04:07:26Z). Referenced by its dated name; ClinVarVCVRelease_00-latest.xml.gz is a symlink to it and is never the reference. Monthly releases are generated on the first Thursday of the month. Not committed.

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV weekly release
@graph.description: Weekly releases are named ClinVarVCVRelease_YYYY-MMDD.xml.gz under weekly_release/, and NCBI clears that directory when the monthly release is generated. Listed over FTP on 2026-09-06, the directory held only the symlink ClinVarVCVRelease_00-latest_weekly.xml.gz -> ../ClinVarVCVRelease_2026-09.xml.gz and its .md5 (same digest as the monthly), so the weekly is currently the monthly file (sameAs) and has no content of its own. This entity therefore carries no contentUrl, contentSize, md5, version or datePublished: a Bridge must not resolve it into a second pass over the monthly release. When a dated weekly exists, record its contentUrl, md5 (from the sibling .md5), contentSize and datePublished (from the HTTPS headers) and version here, and drop sameAs.

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV XSD, version 2.6
@graph.description: Pinned byte for byte at ../schema/ClinVar_VCV_2.6.xsd. Its version attribute reads "2.6; February 26, 2026"; dateModified is the HTTPS Last-Modified. md5 is NCBI's sibling .md5 file, checked against the download; sha256 is computed locally. ClinVar_VCV.xsd and ClinVar_VCV_weekly.xsd on the same site publish the same md5. It supersedes 2.5 (md5 169e958e2f06c6a3ba8a96aae3a949a9, "2.5; August 6, 2025"); the whole difference is one optional derived_by attribute, enumerated to NCBI, on SetElementSetType. The 2026-09 monthly release declares 2.6, which is why 2.6 and not 2.5 is pinned.
